title: Tensor formula for actual semilinear reduction adjoints
statement: Let J be a site and B a strict inverse sequence of sheaves of commutative rings. Use the actual system category, its derived evaluation functors e_n, reduction adjoints alpha_h, and simultaneous section-normalized tensor comparisons of [def-coef-semilinear-system-models, def-coef-semilinear-derived-calculus]. For every two objects P,Q of the unbounded derived system category, and every n ≤ m with h : n ≤ m, alpha_h(P tensor^L Q) followed by tensorEvaluation_n equals scalar_h(tensorEvaluation_m) followed by scalarTensor_h and then tensor(alpha_h(P), alpha_h(Q)). This equality concerns the adjoints of the actual horizontal transitions. Neither P nor Q is assumed normalized. No boundedness or flatness of the coefficient homomorphisms is assumed.

proof.text: Choose K-flat resolutions with flat terms of the two system objects. Evaluation preserves K-flatness by its model field and flat terms by the vertical finite-relation argument. The total tensor is K-flat with flat terms by the existing total-tensor model theorem.

proof.text: The evaluation and scalar tensor model derived squares identify the remaining maps. Naturality of the tensor model and scalar counit completes a diagram of nine commuting squares. Cancel its invertible comparisons to obtain the formula on K-flat representatives. Both sides are components of natural transformations of the pair of derived system objects; transport their equality along the representative isomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem tensor_reduction_formula (A : Data.{c, v, r} J B τ)
    (P Q : DS.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ) :
    ∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m),
      reduction.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ h (A.scalar h) (A.closed.tensor.obj (P, Q)) ≫
          (A.tensorEvaluation n).hom.app (P, Q) =
        (A.scalar h).T.map ((A.tensorEvaluation m).hom.app (P, Q)) ≫
          (A.scalarTensor h).hom.app
            ((e.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ m).obj P, (e.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ m).obj Q) ≫
          (A.levelClosed n).tensor.map
            (Prod.mkHom (reduction.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ h (A.scalar h) P)
              (reduction.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ h (A.scalar h) Q))
